top_signals.title: Bitcoin tops $65,000 after ‘massive surprise’ US jobs miss
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin topped $65,000 after U.S. payrolls fell 23,000 in July versus an 80,000 forecast, pushing traders to price out a September Fed rate hike.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Coldcard bitcoin exploit exposes crypto’s ‘original sin’ of private keys, Blockaid CEO says
top_signals.summary: Crypto at risk of becoming "canary in a coal mine" when it comes to demonstrating how AI could impact cybersecurity.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Elevator giant Otis wants to be a defensive play in a volatile market. It has to prove itself first
top_signals.summary: Otis positions itself as a long-term growth stock, but shares are down due to setbacks in its elevator service business and investors chasing the AI trade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
